# MAS MENA

> MAS MENA is a full-service marketing agency based in Amman, Jordan. It delivers creative, data-driven campaigns, online and offline, for brands in FMCG, healthcare, beauty and more across Jordan, the GCC and the wider Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. It works Arabic-first, using local dialects and market research so campaigns fit regional culture.

Also known as: MAS, Masmena, Modern Advanced Services.

## Services

- Influencer & creator marketing: influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, creator partnerships, campaign strategy and management, performance tracking and reporting
- Content production: short-form video production; professional, commercial, lifestyle, corporate and product photography
- Social media: content planning and strategy, community management, audience engagement, moderation and customer interaction
- Digital marketing: search engine optimization (SEO) and digital PR, generative engine optimization (GEO) and AI search visibility, media outreach, online reputation
- E-commerce: Shopify store development, conversion rate optimization, e-commerce strategy, customer journey optimization
- Experiential: brand activations, pop-up experiences, consumer engagement events, on-ground campaigns

## Markets

Jordan, the GCC (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman) and the wider MENA region. MAS MENA also manages international campaigns.

## Selected clients

Super Drink, Wild Tiger Energy, Chupa Chups, MOG, Serene, Mr. King, Iced Chai Karak.
